name: docstore
description: Bundles two SurrealDB MCP servers (docs, memory) plus skills and hooks that force agents to retrieve from and write to the probata document store, ADR/decision log, MASTER-TODO register, session handoffs, and agent memory instead of guessing from the filesystem. 0.2.0 (2026-09-10): cloud store surreal-docs, commands /recall-doc /recall-adr /memory /update-adr, query skill.
